author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Six-tooth outline gear with a hub dot (tapered teeth, mirrored top/bottom) gripped by curled fingers (an r8 lobe over its right side), the back of the hand arching over to the wrist and the palm edge running down from under the gear, as in the reference. The before's stepped plus-shaped gear did not read as a gear.
omissions: The gear's hub ring is a dot (a ring needs a larger gear than the budget allows); the two right-hand teeth are hidden behind the fingers.
